title: Peyton Is 11–0, and a 21% Underdog Next Week
dek: Peyton beats Trey to stay perfect, Dustin comes back from 34% to upset Chris & Miguel, and Connor & Kunal hang another 151.0 before their date with the unbeaten team.

sections.head: The lead
body: Peyton is 11–0. The Loose Stools beat Trey 123.5–101.2, the win streak is now 11, and Mack's record of 15 from 2024 is 4 away. It is the best start in Brown Cow since Mack opened 14–0 that same year. Peyton leads the series with Trey 8–6.

Now the bill arrives. Next week Peyton visits Connor & Kunal, the league's top-rated team at **+10.0** against Peyton's +1.1. Got New Legs is projected to win 138.3–110.9 and gets a 79% chance; Peyton's best projected starter is Parker Washington at 17.7, while Jahmyr Gibbs is projected for 25.6 on the other side. Both teams have clinched their divisions, so nothing rides on it but the streak and the argument. Peyton leads that series 8–6.

sections.head: Comeback of the week
body: Dustin was down to a 34% win chance at Sun 8:54pm and still beat Chris & Miguel 112.1–94.8, an upset over a team rated 120 Elo points higher. Ashton Jeanty's 68-yd TD catch swung the matchup 25% toward Bad JuJu and turned out to be a footnote. Chris & Miguel still lead the series 11–5.

The win lifted Dustin's playoff odds from 19% to 33%, and the power ratings have Slangin Jive Turkeys at **+1.2**, third in the league and a tick ahead of an 11–0 Peyton. At 4–7. The replays are on the site.

sections.head: Around the league
body: Connor & Kunal beat John 151.0–121.8 for the week's top score. They are averaging 151.3 a game; the season record is 141.8, set by Kevin in 2018. If the year ended now, they would rank first of 166 team-seasons in league history by dominance.

Mack beat Nathan 120.8–66.9, the blowout of the week by 53.9, and Nathan's 66.9 was the week's low. Mack is 9–2 and the luck table says he scored like a 6.1-win team; Peyton is tied with him at +2.9 wins of good fortune.

Mike Yang beat Mike Barry 132.3–101.7, and Mike Barry left 33.0 points on his bench, enough to have won it. Kevin beat Andrew & Nick 98.5–83.6, with Breece Hall's 7-yd TD catch swinging it 27%. The biggest single swing of the week belonged to Trey: Sam LaPorta's 2 catches for 58 yds moved his matchup 42%, and he lost anyway.

sections.head: The playoff picture
body: Five seats are spoken for in all but paperwork. Connor & Kunal, Peyton and Mack have clinched their divisions, Mike Yang is at 100%, and Chris & Miguel slipped only to 97% after the loss.
The sixth seat now has a leader: Dustin at 33%, then Trey at 25% (down from 31%), Kevin at 17% (up from 5%), Nathan at 13% and Mike Barry at 11%. John fell to 3% and Andrew & Nick to 2%.

sections.head: Game of the Week
body: Mike Barry vs Dustin carries the biggest playoff swing on the board, 60%. Dustin is projected 122.2–120.2 with a 52% chance, Trevor Lawrence is projected for 23.3 and CeeDee Lamb for 20.3 on the other side, and Mike Barry leads the series 9–6.

Close behind: Kevin vs Nathan, a 47% swing, with Nathan projected 115.8–105.6 and favored at 62%. Kevin leads that series 11–6. And Mike Yang, one win from career win No. 100, gets a 9–2 Mack he is projected to beat 141.2–110.4.

groupme: Week 11 issue is up. Peyton is 11–0 and next week gets Connor & Kunal, rated +10.0 to his +1.1, as a 21% underdog. Dustin came back from 34% to knock off Chris & Miguel and now leads the race for the last playoff seat. Mike Barry left 33.0 on his bench and lost. And the Game of the Week is Mike Barry vs Dustin, with a 60% playoff swing riding on it.
